issue_context.title: The `locate` function will loop infinitely in some situation
issue_context.body:
The SQL below will never finish
_**select locate('DB', 'TiDB is a NewSQL sytle DB', 6);**_

## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql
select position('world' in 'hello,world');
select position('world' in 'hello world');
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

In MySQL:

```sql
+------------------------------------+
| position('world' in 'hello,world') |
+------------------------------------+
| 7                                  |
+------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.032s

+------------------------------------+
| position('world' in 'hello world') |
+------------------------------------+
| 7                                  |
+------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.008s
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

In TiDB:

```sql
+------------------------------------+
| position('world' in 'hello,world') |
+------------------------------------+
| 7                                  |
+------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.007s

+------------------------------------+
| position('world' in 'hello world') |
+------------------------------------+
| 8                                  |
+------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.003s
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

```sql
+-----------------------------------------+
| version()                               |
+-----------------------------------------+
| 5.7.25-TiDB-v6.2.0-alpha-101-gb91bdd087 |
+-----------------------------------------+
```
comments: The problem caused by `locateStringWithCollation`, in TiDB we will cutting out the spaces at the end when transfer it with collations. :(
